visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman wearing a floral patterned shirt, a black face mask, and a strawberry-print apron is skillfully slicing a large, crispy slab of roasted pork on a red cutting board. She uses clear plastic gloves and a large metal knife to cut the meat into thick, uniform strips. (2) Close-up shots detail the texture of the roasted pork, highlighting its golden-brown, crackling skin and juicy interior as it is sliced and placed into a metal tray. The background shows a street-side stall setup with various plastic containers and a blue basket. (3) The scene shifts to the assembly of a Vietnamese baguette. A hand in a plastic glove cuts the bread open, and several ingredients are added sequentially: a dark sauce, pickled vegetables, fresh cucumber slices, and a generous amount of the sliced roasted pork. (4) The camera focuses on the finished Banh Mi, displaying the rich layers of meat and vegetables tucked inside the toasted crust. Two sandwiches are held up in front of the stall's glass display, which is filled with more baguettes. (5) A final wide shot shows the exterior of the stall, '玉仙越式法國麵包', located on a paved urban street with buildings and traffic signs visible in the distance under bright daylight.
